Market today: Stocks are rallying, driven by record profit margins. This is good for your tech/chip focus, but leverage amplifies swings.

Your holdings: SOXL is a SELL/TRIM candidate (-42.88% PnL) due to its leveraged nature and decay. SPAL is also a SELL/TRIM (-38.21% PnL) for similar reasons. Remember, margin makes these drops hurt more.

Watch: Keep an eye on QQQ and TQQQ scanner setups for potential accumulation if they continue to show strength.

Bottom line: Manage your leveraged positions and watch for opportunities in broader tech indices.
plays: Trim SOXL: Its leveraged decay is a drag, especially on margin. Consider reducing exposure.
Trim SPAL: Similar to SOXL, this leveraged ETF is a candidate for trimming due to decay and volatility.
Consider QQQ/TQQQ accumulation: Scanner setups suggest potential entries if they hold their levels.
